evidence_summary: Born in the ski jumping town of Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, Raška was introduced to the sport by his cousin and uncle, both active jumpers. He joined coach Zdeněk Remsa's legendary 'Remsa Boys' training group and was placed in the military sports club Dukla Liberec, which concentrated elite athletic opportunity. evidence_summary: Born in Most, Czechoslovakia, Svoboda played in the Czechoslovak league as a teenager before defecting to the West at age 17 in 1984 to pursue professional hockey at a higher level. He was drafted 5th overall by the Montreal Canadiens in the 1984 NHL Entry Draft and immediately made the team as an 18-year-old rookie, playing 73 games.
